name: Target Food Distribution Center Cedar Falls (T0590)

fieldNotes.location: Geocoded point (42.5077,-92.41034 / 3400 Cedar Heights Dr) was wrong - landed in a residential/retail area ~6km NE. Correct facility is the Target Food Distribution Center at 2115 Technology Pkwy / 6601 Hudson Rd, Cedar Falls, confirmed by Iowa DNR Facility Explorer (facID 311387103, coords 42.47508,-92.46961) sitting on this building's SE office wing.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck yard is fully enclosed by black metal perimeter fence (visible in 2026-04 Street View along the east side). Single controlled truck entrance off the SE internal access drive. Driver reviews explicitly reference 'the security gate' and a 'guard shack'.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Driver reviews describe a staffed guard shack at the gate with a pneumatic-tube ('cylinders that you put the bills in and gets shot to the office like at a bank') document-exchange system - a manned booth, not a kiosk.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a staffed guard shack is present (per driver reviews); not an unmanned kiosk/app check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Three dock banks: north face (facing the GM DC shared aisle), south face (over the drop yard), and a west apron. Combined door count well over 50; estimate ~58.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on opposite (north and south) building faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple full rows of reefer trailers parked without tractors in the south yard (z19/z20 imagery); 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad visible in the truck path.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town site on Hudson Rd surrounded by farmland and a retention pond; Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: False - large Target campus on a developed industrial parkway with adjacent office buildings; cellular coverage expected to be fine.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron between the gate and the dock faces can hold queued trucks (inferred from overhead); flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
